Method of Attack: Heap overflow in the firmware of Broadcom Wi-Fi chips
Exploitation occurs when the device receives a WME (Quality-of-Service) information element with a malformed length from a connected network
Allows attacker to execute code on devices without any user interaction
Impacted Systems: Android devices using Broadcom Wi-Fi chips
iOS devices using Broadcom Wi-Fi chips
Devices with Broadcom BCM43xx family of Wi-Fi chips from vendors such as Google (Nexus), Samsung, HTC, and LG
Attack Vector: Receiving malformed WME information element from a Wi-Fi network
Victim device being in range of attacker's Wi-Fi network (no user interaction or connection required)
